about: PROPOSED for the kit (03_Master_Data\FMC_Rulebook\FMC_Rulebook_RoomServices.json), drafted 19 Oct 2026 for the engineering-services track (Auto-MEP E4 and recipe-tree step T2 room rule sets). Owner direction 19 Oct 2026: draft with values marked 'assumed' from the standards; a person approves before anything uses them as standard. EVERY value below is source_status 'assumed': none is verified, none is a design. The building services engineer, the public health engineer, the fire engineer and (for hospitals) the client's medical-equipment and infection-control leads confirm or replace each value per project. A room type with no entry for a service gets none by rule; a person adds what the brief needs.
